input.overview: Peter Brock / Holden turns the same physical shots into different themed letter progress. Complete the five top lanes for an immediate two-ball Multiball, or repeat the six-bank and top-saucer lock sequence for three-ball Multiball. The six white targets on the right build a separate collection that eventually starts four-ball Multiball.
input.simpleOverview: Complete the five top lanes to start the shortest Multiball route: B-R-O-C-K on Peter Brock or M-O-T-O-R on Holden. The lower lanes and six-bank build separate bonuses and larger Multiballs.
input.summary: Use the flipper buttons to move the lit top lane, then complete B-R-O-C-K on Peter Brock or M-O-T-O-R on Holden for two-ball Multiball. For three-ball Multiball, complete the six-bank, collect a virtual lock at the top saucer, and repeat until the third lock starts the feature.

quickInfo.name: Two-ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Complete the five top lanes: B-R-O-C-K on Peter Brock or M-O-T-O-R on Holden.

quickInfo.name: Three-ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Complete the six drop targets, shoot the top saucer for a virtual lock, and repeat until the third lock starts Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Four-ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Complete the six white targets on the right to add a Peter Brock win or Holden car; collect all nine wins or six cars.

quickInfo.name: Lower lanes
quickInfo.summary: Complete R-A-C-E on Peter Brock or C-A-R-S on Holden to raise Bonus X, enable the 1,000-point Super Spinner, and light Mystery during single-ball play.

steps.text: Use the flipper buttons to move the lit top lane, then complete B-R-O-C-K on Peter Brock or M-O-T-O-R on Holden to start two-ball Multiball.
For the three-ball route, knock down all six LEGEND targets on Peter Brock or all six HOLDEN targets on Holden to light Lock.
Shoot the top saucer to collect the virtual lock, then repeat the six-bank and saucer sequence until the third lock starts three-ball Multiball.
During three-ball Multiball, repeat the right ramp for a Jackpot that increases with consecutive ramp shots.
Complete the six white WINNER targets on Peter Brock or GARAGE targets on Holden to add one themed collection item.
Repeat until Peter Brock has all nine wins or Holden has all six cars; completing the collection starts four-ball Multiball.
During four-ball Multiball, repeat the right ramp for an increasing Jackpot.

playfieldReferences.label: B-R-O-C-K / M-O-T-O-R top lanes
playfieldReferences.description: The five rollover lanes used for the two-ball Multiball start.

playfieldReferences.label: LEGEND / HOLDEN drop bank
playfieldReferences.description: The six-bank that lights each virtual lock at the top saucer.

playfieldReferences.label: Virtual lock saucer
playfieldReferences.description: The upper saucer that collects each of the three virtual locks.

playfieldReferences.term: six white targets on the right
playfieldReferences.label: WINNER / GARAGE targets
playfieldReferences.description: The right-side target group that adds wins or cars toward four-ball Multiball.

cautions.issue: Peter Brock and Holden use different insert words and collection totals.
cautions.response: On Peter Brock, use B-R-O-C-K, R-A-C-E, LEGEND, and nine WINNER awards. On Holden, use M-O-T-O-R, C-A-R-S, HOLDEN, and six GARAGE awards.

cautions.issue: Version 1 may not include features added by later software.
cautions.response: Use these physical starts, but follow the display if later software changes a value or adds a feature.
